snippet_primary: "I am writing this to express my deep dissatisfaction with Patreons service and support. I am giving a 1-star because the platform has refused to issue a refund despite clear evidence that I was scammed. I subscribed to a creator who didt deliver the promised content and misled their patrons. Despite reporting this fraud, Patreon's support team chose to hide behind rigid policies rather than protecting me from a clear scam. By allowing such creators to keep the money without consequences, Patreon is failing its community and enabling fraudulent behavior. This is completely unacceptable, and everybody please avoid this platform!!!!!"
subject_exact: buyer denied a refund by Patreon after reporting a creator who did not deliver promised content
